CONE_SLICE empty so trace wins; this swap explains zero progress.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -401,7 +401,7 @@
 	always @* begin
 		(* full_case *)
 		case (mem_wordsize)
-			0: begin
+			2: begin
 				mem_la_wdata = reg_op2;
 				mem_la_wstrb = 4'b1111;
 				mem_rdata_word = mem_rdata;
@@ -414,7 +414,7 @@
 				endcase
 			end
-			2: begin
+			0: begin
 				mem_la_wdata = {4{reg_op2[7:0]}};
 				mem_la_wstrb = 4'b0001 << reg_op1[1:0];
 				case (reg_op1[1:0])
